scopes.warning: Full access to your account, including your email address and any scopes added in the future.

scopes.description: Direct catalog lookups: books, editions, authors, series, characters, publishers
Your library and reading progress (public + following + private)
Public profile fields (id, name, username, avatar)
Your Hardcover roles (librarian_roles, including hardcover_admin for staff)
Read other users generated content (reading status, reviews, etc.)
Your account data: imports, subscriptions, referrals, flags
Add and update books in your library (includes reading journal and imports)
Create and update lists (includes filter lists and followed lists)
Follow users, like content, block users
Mark notifications read and update notification settings
Edit book mappings (requires book_mapper librarian role)
Split books and editions (requires edition_splitter librarian role)
